labels.text: In the Netherlands, the governing coalition collapses and Prime Minister Mark Rutte announces his upcoming resignation.
2023 Dutch general election: Far-right Geert Wilders' Party for Freedom (PVV) wins the most seats.
The Caribbean guilder is introduced, replacing the Netherlands Antillean guilder as the currency for Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
A NATO summit is held at the World Forum in The Hague, Netherlands.
2025 Dutch general election: Social liberal party Democrats 66 ties with right-wing populist party Party for Freedom in most number of seats.
The 2025 World Women's Handball Championship is held in Germany and the Netherlands, and is won by Norway.
2025–2026 Dutch cabinet formation: Rob Jetten is sworn in as Prime Minister of the Netherlands, heading a minority government.
